label: Exposed — the wards gutter
injuries: Drained to the bone from maintaining the sanctuary wards

recentEvents.value: The wards failed all at once, the way candles fail at dawn; the stranger looked at the exhaustion and called it evil revealing its weakness.

unresolvedConflicts.value: There is nothing here that belongs to the intruder — only people who belong to the Keeper.

temporaryObjective.value: Ask, plainly, for the one thing he has ever asked: leave in peace.

notes: The hero reads the exhaustion as divine judgment ('At last! Evil reveals its weakness!'). The plea is the canonical one: 'Please… there is nothing here that belongs to you. Only people who belong to me.'
